architecture_delta_fusion.material_current_gap: F2 needs independent process/file/network/resource/tool-call witness evidence for WP005/WP605/WP902/WP904, while canonical effect outcome and completion authority must remain in the EntityOS EffectGate/EffectJournal lane.
architecture_delta_fusion.control_plane_constraint: Private clay-global-research-entity GitHub Actions remains a zero-step pre-admission blocker; no AgentSight or F2 runtime claim is derived from that transport state.

source_grounded_findings.finding: AgentSight is a local-first system-level observability tool that can correlate agent/model/tool activity with process, file, network and resource events; live eBPF/TLS capture is external to the target application rather than an SDK-only integration.

The current report-export snapshot has explicit schema_version=1 and exposes process_nodes, audit_events, resource_samples, sessions and tool_calls; consumers are instructed to reject unsupported schema versions and tolerate additive fields.

Current AuditEventRow, ProcessNodeRow and ToolCallRow carry view_source and confidence; ToolCallRow additionally carries tool_call_id, related_pid and related_event_id. This materially improves provenance-safe external consumption compared with the earlier AgentSight state discussed in issue#44.

AgentSight explicitly states that view_source is row lineage, not logical-operation identity, and confidence is source-specific rather than a globally comparable probability. F2 must not upgrade these fields into canonical causal identity or truth confidence.

Live eBPF-backed record/debug capture is Linux- and privilege-sensitive; non-eBPF modes can fall back to native agent session files or process snapshots. Therefore a F2 witness adapter must preserve capture mode and must never label transcript/native-session fallback as kernel-observed evidence.

Exported snapshots may contain command lines, argv, paths, network destinations, audit details and tool inputs/outputs, including secrets or user data. Any F2 ingestion requires field minimization, redaction policy and explicit retention boundaries.

AgentSight's paper/README reports less than 3 percent overhead for typical traced workloads. This remains an upstream claim only and receives zero F2 performance credit until an equivalent F2 workload is measured.

AgentSight issue#44 explicitly separates live/persisted observability from deterministic signed/digested proof bundles and release-governance artifacts. This supports using AgentSight as a witness source rather than as F2 EffectAuthority or completion proof. The relevant maintainer-side comment was marked AI-generated and pending maintainer review, so it is retained as discussion evidence rather than authoritative product contract.

proposed_thin_boundary: Ingest only an explicitly pinned AgentSight snapshot/schema version or a deliberately narrow capture API.
Map AgentSight rows into typed witness evidence while preserving view_source, confidence, capture mode, source commit and snapshot digest.
Bind tool_call_id/related_pid/related_event_id to F2 invocation identity only when an explicit deterministic adapter proves the mapping; otherwise retain as foreign witness identifiers.
Keep all world-effect verdicts and canonical completion decisions outside AgentSight and inside the existing EntityOS EffectGate/EffectJournal path.
Prefer structural distillation over wholesale dependency adoption unless a later F2 ablation shows positive marginal value.

counterhypotheses: F2-native telemetry can provide the same useful witness coverage with lower privilege/dependency/privacy cost.
AgentSight correlation identifiers may be insufficient to establish exact F2 per-invocation causal identity across child/tool/process boundaries.
eBPF/TLS capture and sensitive payload retention may introduce more operational risk than diagnostic value for normal F2 runs.
A deterministic proof-bundle or narrower syscall/process witness may be a better complement to F2 than the full AgentSight stack.

required_next_discriminator.experiment: Build a minimal read-only adapter against a pinned AgentSight v1 snapshot fixture, including one kernel/view row and one agent_native_session/fallback row, and verify that F2 preserves provenance class without minting canonical effect/completion credit.
acceptance: fallback/native-session evidence is never reclassified as kernel-observed.
foreign tool_call_id remains noncanonical unless an explicit bijection is proven.
sensitive payload fields can be excluded while retaining measurement utility.
No AgentSight observation can directly finalize EffectJournal or completion state.
measure_later_on_f2: diagnostic value on F2-WP-904 failure injection
